Info

The above lyrics are for a studio take of BACKSTREETS recorded sometime between May and July 1975 at The Record Plant in New York City, NY. See the album version for more details about the studio sessions.

This is an unfinished version (see the third verse) featuring alternate lyrics that considerably vary from those of the album version. It can be found on several bootlegs, including War And Roses (E. St. Records).

Bruce Springsteen -- War And Roses (E. St. Records)

In late 2005, Sirius XM's E Street Radio channel suddenly started playing a different mix (featuring different guitar) of this same take of BACKSTREETS. This quickly resulted in an mp3 recording making the rounds.

Credits

Thanks Jake (ol'catfishinthelake at BTX and Greasy Lake) for the lyrics help.
